description: Canonical evaluation protocol for A0/A1/A2 comparison

corrections_2026_09_28.reason: QA Quality Stabilization Experiment 1 — answer reconstruction via tokenizer character offsets

answer_decoding.status: SUPERSEDED — the string above is preserved verbatim as the method used for every result recorded before 2026-09-28
answer_decoding.now: answer text is sliced from the ORIGINAL context using the offsets from return_offsets_mapping=True (single shared implementation: backend/answer_span.py); decode() remains only as a fallback for spans that cannot be mapped onto the context
answer_decoding.effect: decode() re-inserts spaces at subword boundaries, corrupting values the tokenizer split ('142.6 million' -> '142. 6 million', '$4,900' -> '$ 4, 900', '2011-2020' -> '2011 - 2020'). Every EM/F1 value recorded before this change understates accuracy for numeric, date, currency and percentage answers.
answer_decoding.re_run: phase4f/phase4f_5/evaluation/A0_test_results.json, A1_test_results.json, A2_test_results.json (re-generated 2026-09-28 with the corrected decoding); pre-fix copies at phase4f/phase4f_5/results/

token_f1.definition: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) on word tokens

answerability.definition: fraction of answerable examples where pred != ''

abstention_accuracy.definition: fraction of unanswerable examples where pred == ''

false_abstention.definition: fraction of answerable examples where pred == ''

spurious_answers.definition: fraction of all examples where question_kind == UNANSWERABLE and pred != ''

latency_ms.definition: average inference time per example in milliseconds

failure_taxonomy.EXTRACT: pred != '' and pred != gold and question_kind != UNANSWERABLE

checkpoint_selection.test_usage: NEVER for selection. TEST is for final reporting only.

reporting.primary_comparison: A0 vs A1 vs A2 on TEST split
